correctness.rationale: The self-contained five-step proof identifies the exact integer domain, proves the three-layer lower bound, shows sharpness by explicit cyclic constructions, excludes any full layer at the minimum through a global excess budget of at most two, classifies all remaining monochromatic positive runs with distinct adjacent run colors, and counts labelled cyclic gap compositions times proper q-colorings. A literal graph-based verifier exhaustively checked all vertex subsets up to the predicted optimum in seven parameter profiles (786909 subsets). Finite checks do not replace the universal proof.

evidence: Kuenzel–Rall prove the scalar i(C_n×K_q)=ceil(2n/3), explicitly for n>=6 and q>=3, and give optimum examples.
Bakal–Mane prove a corresponding ordinary domination minimum and three-column inequality, which by itself does not determine independent-optimal multiplicities.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new assertion is neither that a minimum exists nor merely the known optimum value. It identifies every optimum set and counts them exactly. Those counts are computable in principle from the broad prior finite-state characterization, so a possible implicit-corollary objection remains a genuine residual risk; however, the documented literature does not already furnish the required slack rigidity, cycle-coloring count or equivalent closed specialization.

originality.rationale: The published scalar minimum and general weak-partition characterization are substantial antecedents. The present unrestricted multiplicity formula and all-optimal-sets colored-gap bijection were not found in the inspected full accessible primary discussions; the residual risk of an equivalent implicit or unindexed enumeration is stated explicitly.
residual_risks: General weak partitions from arxiv:1901.03218 and arxiv:2203.12397 conceptually determine all maximal independent sets, so the new closed extremizer count may be independently derivable as an unstated corollary.
Synonymous or unindexed enumerations, perhaps in categorical-product and combinatorial-coloring literatures, cannot be ruled out by the conducted searches.
The more recent arxiv:2506.11865 has a related three-column lower bound, so only the equality rigidity and exact independent-optimal multiplicity can be asserted as additional.
Only same-model scientific review and finite computations have occurred; no independent mathematical validation.

value.rationale: The source literature explicitly studies independent domination on C_n×K_q and determines its scalar optimum, making the number and structure of optimum sets a motivated, exact invariant. This classification covers all n>=6 and q>=3, translates the entire optimum family into cyclic compositions and chromatic-cycle colorings, and gives an exponential closed multiplicity with residue-class effects. It is neither a parameter relabelling nor the already-known scalar minimum; no full polynomial or outside-range claims are made.
